name: NeRF-RCNN
definition: A network that takes a pre-trained NeRF as input and outputs 3D Axis-Aligned Bounding Boxes (AABB), class labels, and discrete 3D masks of detected objects.
summary: NeRF-RCNN is a proposal-based 3D instance segmentation model that refines NeRF-RPN proposals into discrete 3D masks and bounding boxes, unlike Semantic-NeRF which lacks instance-level data.
